hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: A_i = O_i[F], where O_G0001[F]=Δ_{x,y}F, O_G0002[F]=D_xF, O_G0003[F]=(D_xF-Δ_{x,y}F)/(x-y)
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: G0001 is the first divided difference of f on nodes x,y; G0002 is the derivative f'(x), interpretable as the first Hermite divided difference on repeated node x; G0003 is the second Hermite divided difference on repeated node x and node y.
